title: add-constraint-driven-rag-templates-and-typed-tool-stubs
author: Lina Park
description: Introduce a set of constraint-driven RAG authoring templates and a tiny TypeScript typed-tool-stub example to help teams author structured tool contracts and validate outputs during local authoring. Motivation: many teams author RAG playbooks by hand and lack small, opinionated templates that encode common constraints (max_context_tokens, required_tool_response_schema, fallback_policy) together with lightweight smoke tests. This PR adds documentation, an examples package, a minimal validation script, and a CI smoke test to catch regressions. Checklist: [x] docs: new constraint-driven template guide; [x] examples: typed tool stub + README; [x] tooling: local validate script + CI smoke test; [x] telemetry: add snippet for console instrumentation examples; [ ] follow-up: add IDE snippets in separate PR. Related: Linear ENG-4829, DOC-210. See inline commits and CI logs for full context.
